description: File browsing, document sharing, export, and event gateway tools for jeeves-server.

configRoot.description: Platform config root directory; core derives component config dirs from it. Written by `jeeves install`. Falls back to the JEEVES_CONFIG_ROOT environment variable. Until one is set, the plugin loads and its tools work, except server_service install, which is unavailable.
